description: Default permissions for the main window. The filesystem scope is deliberately everything the user can reach: Forgemark opens whatever file it is pointed at, and the review it writes goes back beside it. The CSP in tauri.conf.json is what stands between a reviewed document and that scope. Dot-folders are in scope too (plugins.fs.requireLiteralLeadingDot in tauri.conf.json): the agent skill is installed under ~/.claude, ~/.codex, and ~/.agents. The opener may hand any path to its default application, or to the Claude app, which is how the agent skill is installed there.
